name: Pixel
shortDescription: A pocket-sized spark with quick wings, a curious stare, and far more nerve than its scale suggests.

name: Vhrax
shortDescription: A lean young hunter built for sharp turns, sudden climbs, and vanishing into high cloud.

name: Dreamfyre
shortDescription: A pale blue she-dragon whose silver markings and smoke-blue flame made her unmistakable in flight.

name: Caraxes
shortDescription: The Blood Wyrm: battle-scarred, red-scaled, and famous for an unusually long neck and ferocious temper.

name: Vhagar
shortDescription: The last living dragon of Aegon's Conquest era, ancient enough to make castles look temporary.
